The preceding notebooks are exploratory: you run them top to bottom and the
result stays in the scene. For a figure you intend to publish you also need to
say exactly what ran, with which parameters and which seed, and to have someone
else repeat it.

SciGraphs has a declarative system for that. A JSON or YAML specification
describes the whole pipeline (data, analysis, layout, styling, render, exports)
and the executor replays it step by step, writing a provenance manifest with
hashes. This notebook drives that system from Python: explore in a notebook,
then freeze the result as a specification.

For the same thing from the sidebar or from a terminal, see the
[Reproducibility panel](../panels/scigraphs/reproducibility.qmd), the
[pipeline schema](../guide/pipeline-schema.qmd) and
[Tutorial 5](../examples/05-reproducible-pipeline.qmd).
